issues.title: Material Table icons missing
issues.body:
I'm viewing the `My Orders` tab in  `Planning Channel`.

For the left-hand expand/collapse button I just see "ch".  For the show filters button I see `fil`, and for the `only show my orders` toggle button I see `oe`.

I see lots of icons in other parts of the UI - including the ones for `submit lesson learned/feedback` and `Re-play tutorial` buttons just under the time control.

I guess we need to switch the source library for our icons to use the same as that one.  It does look like `material-table` doesn't mind where the icon comes from:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/201082144-0dea916a-f9e6-4586-ba9a-e1db85e02f3f.png)

Note: I've found how to swap the icons, but I haven't looked for ones that match what we need ;-)

We need these: 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/201099670-c427cb37-37ad-474c-a52b-b75a7fdc7783.png)


Ok, here is how to use a font-awesome icon:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/201098942-9c7cdee8-47ba-46fe-ac82-79cc0b8fb1ee.png)

And here is how it is rendered:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/201099006-ff243be5-d58a-40a4-99c6-1e42957cec6b.png)

comments.body:
Need `filter` icon that is shown in header cell when table filters switched on

Also - our icons are only single state. The icon stays solid, whether switched on or not. _Somehow_ we need to toggle them in the way `material-table` expects to.
